title: Bregman-projected mirror methods for regularized stationary mean-field games
summary: We develop and analyze a Bregman-projected mirror iteration for low-order regularizations of stationary mean-field game (MFG) systems in their natural Banach space setting. For separable Hamiltonians of the form $H(x,p,m)=H_0(x,p)-g(m)$, with quadratic or super-quadratic Hamiltonian growth and linear or super-linear density couplings, we formulate a low-order $\barγ$-Laplacian regularization of the stationary MFG system as a variational inequality on $L^{\barβ}(\mathbb T^d)\times W^{1,\barγ}(\mathbb T^d)$.
